description: This file defines a Data class for managing data associated with DOM elements or objects, including methods for setting, getting, removing, and checking data, as well as handling internal cache and unique identifiers.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: A class for managing data cache associated with DOM elements or objects.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a unique key for the owner object, creating a cache if necessary.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets data for an owner object, either as key-value pairs or as an object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with an owner object for a specific key.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Gets or sets data depending on provided arguments; acts as a combined getter/setter.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes data entries for an owner object, supporting multiple keys.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks if an owner object has any associated data.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Deletes all data associated with an owner object.
